bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
found="$(find /home/gace -type f -name servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
temp=""
if [ -z "$found" ]; then
 temp="$(mktemp -d)"
 trap 'test -z "$temp" || rm -rf -- "$temp"' EXIT
 git clone -q --depth=1 https://github.com/G-ACE-inc/server-core.git "$temp/core" || exit 61
 found="$temp/core/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py"
fi
test -f "$found" || exit 62
cd "$(dirname "$(dirname "$found")")"
for request in req_6ace20261122133000000056; do
 python3 -B "$found" "$request" --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
done
